semiconductor_relevance: High — The company is directly involved in wafer fabrication services, a critical part of the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Shanghai Huali Microelectronics Corporation (Huahong Group) provides wafer fabrication services, specializing in the production of integrated circuits (ICs) using advanced process technologies. The company serves various sectors including consumer electronics, automotive, and telecommunications, focusing on analog, digital, and mixed-signal ICs.
capabilities: Production of analog, digital, and mixed-signal ICs

regional_presence.China: The company operates advanced semiconductor fabrication facilities in China.
